audit_metadata.title: Phase 9.1.4 Canonical Classification Label Reconciliation & Ground-Truth Formulation
audit_metadata.audit_objective: Establish deterministic, uncertainty-grounded canonical classification ground truth (STABLE, EXPANDING, UNUSUAL_CHANGE, AMBIGUOUS), resolve historical report discrepancies, and verify observation-level partition integrity prior to Phase 9.2 model training.

STABLE.formula: (|delta_area| <= 1.0 * sigma_delta) OR (|rel_pct| <= 5.0) OR (delta_area < 0 AND delta_area >= -3.0 * sigma_delta AND rel_pct >= -20.0)
STABLE.physical_rationale: Captures observations within the 1-sigma delineation noise floor, negligible +/-5% relative fluctuations, or moderate non-catastrophic seasonal shrinkage (evaporation/border freeze-thaw).

EXPANDING.formula: NOT STABLE AND delta_area > 1.0 * sigma_delta AND delta_area <= 3.0 * sigma_delta AND rel_pct > 5.0 AND rel_pct <= 20.0
EXPANDING.physical_rationale: Statistically meaningful expansion exceeding observation uncertainty without exhibiting catastrophic multi-sigma surge.

UNUSUAL_CHANGE.formula: (delta_area > 3.0 * sigma_delta AND rel_pct > 20.0) OR (delta_area < -3.0 * sigma_delta AND rel_pct < -20.0)
UNUSUAL_CHANGE.physical_rationale: High-confidence extreme cryospheric events satisfying BOTH multi-sigma statistical significance and large relative magnitude (>20% or <-20%).

AMBIGUOUS.physical_rationale: Observations with conflicting signals between relative magnitude and measurement noise floor. Excluded from supervised training; reserved for operational quality abstention.

category_a.physical_interpretation: Small lakes with relative expansion > 20% but absolute change <= 3.0 sigma (delineation edge noise inflated by small lake area denominator).

category_b.physical_interpretation: Large lakes with absolute expansion > 3.0 sigma but relative expansion <= 20% (statistically significant growth exceeding noise, but modest relative percentage).

category_c.physical_interpretation: Small lakes with relative contraction < -20% but absolute change >= -3.0 sigma (apparent severe relative shrinkage driven by small lake denominator; within 3-sigma noise floor).

category_d.physical_interpretation: Large lakes with absolute contraction < -3.0 sigma but relative shrinkage >= -20% (statistically significant contraction exceeding 3-sigma noise floor, but non-catastrophic relative percentage).

root_cause_analysis_previous_inconsisten.summary: Discrepancies across Phase 12 artifacts arose from inconsistent handling of the 897 ambiguous observations across different reporting scripts.

discrepancy_details.cause: Accurately recorded the true conjunctions of the hybrid definition, explicitly isolating 897 ambiguous observations.

Script initialized labels to STABLE and set cond_expanding = (~cond_stable) & (~cond_unusual) & (d > 0). This forced 500 positive ambiguous observations into EXPANDING (77 + 500 = 577) and the remaining 397 negative ambiguous observations into STABLE (10760 + 397 = 11157), artificially eliminating ambiguous observations.

An intermediate formulation reassigned Category C small-lake negative shrinkage (rel < -20%, N=393) to UNUSUAL_CHANGE (115 + 393 = 508), subtracting them from STABLE (11157 - 393 = 10764), while keeping EXPANDING at 577. This directly contradicted the mathematical formulas written in Section 4.1.

root_cause_analysis_previous_inconsisten.resolution: Phase 9.1.4 establishes the canonical formula where the three physical classes are mutually exclusive, and all 897 ambiguous observations are explicitly accounted for as AMBIGUOUS.

operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.rule_based_risk_engine_status: RiskEngine statuses (SAFE/NORMAL, WATCH, ELEVATED/UNUSUAL_CHANGE, STALE, INSUFFICIENT_DATA) are heuristic operational alert tiers combining sensor discordance, staleness, and arbitrary percentage thresholds. They must NEVER be used as ground-truth training labels.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.abstention_separation: WATCH and INSUFFICIENT_DATA are operational quality/abstention states, NOT physical lake-change categories.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.independent_target_formulation: Supervised labels are constructed strictly from consecutive physical area observations and GLO AREA_UNCERTAINTY, completely independent of the operational rule engine.

scientific_validation_guardrails.exhausted_test_year_2023: 2023 historical test partition (N=1,742) is an exhausted benchmark from NB09. Evaluating 2023 for model selection, thresholding, or hyperparameter tuning is strictly prohibited.
scientific_validation_guardrails.status_of_year_2024: 2024 area values were consumed to form the 2023 target; 2024 has no consecutive next year (2025 unavailable) and cannot be treated as an untouched future holdout.
scientific_validation_guardrails.leakage_prevention: Row-level random splitting is prohibited. Cross-validation must strictly use lake-level grouping (GroupKFold on GLO_ID). Preprocessors must fit strictly on training folds.
scientific_validation_guardrails.phase9_2_recommendation: GO — Canonical labels are deterministic, reproducible, and mathematically reconciled across all artifacts.
